mechanisms.canonicalAuthority: Existing PROJECTS row; canonical revisions advance on canonical commits.
mechanisms.pendingAuthority: META response operations: hash-bound closed patches over one exact canonical row; accepted work and reservation identities cannot be changed by operational writes.
mechanisms.concurrency: Canonical revision plus complete active-state hash and recovery generation checks; current checks also cover same-revision pending operations.
mechanisms.recovery: The same complete checkpoint mechanism captures pending work, bytes and view without accepting it. Restoration does not execute the original commands.
mechanisms.storageFailure: Checkpoint, operational write and commit failures preserve prior active state. Corrupt pending metadata is preserved in quarantine.
mechanisms.idempotency: Exact pending validation and unchanged save retries keep their identities and revision.
